From time to time the eastern merchant {npc:Yasir} anchors his boat next to the port of Ankrahmun, Carlin or Liberty Bay. While he is there, he buys almost all {wiki:Creature Products|creature products} from you. Just talk to him to get the achievement Si, Ariki!.
A merchant arrives at one of the ports to do business.
Only while the Mini World Change is active.
The {wiki:Creature Products|creature products} you want to sell
You can sell almost all {wiki:Creature Products|Creature Products} to Yasir while he is in port
Keep your creature products for when Yasir shows up: it's a rare opportunity.

Yasir has arrived when messages like *"Oriental ships sighted! A trader for exotic creature products may currently be visiting Carlin, Ankrahmun or Liberty Bay."* or *"Hear ye! Hear ye! What a lucky and beautiful day! Visit Carlin, Ankrahmun, or Liberty Bay. Yasir, the oriental trader might be there. Gather your creature products, for this chance is rare."* appear.

{npc:Yasir} anchors off the port of **one** of these cities: **Ankrahmun**, **Carlin** or **Liberty Bay**. Visit the ports until you find him. He stays on his boat, moored at the docks, **1 floor above** the quay: Carlin {coord:32398,31815,6}, Ankrahmun {coord:33104,32885,6} or Liberty Bay {coord:32314,32894,6}. To go from one city to another use the normal boats (for example, the harbour captain with {key:hi}, the city name and {key:yes}).
Yasir at the Liberty Bay docks
The position shown on the map is Carlin's; in the other cities use the coordinates above.
Say {key:hi} and then {key:ariki} or {key:trade} to {npc:Yasir}. You get the achievement straight away and can sell him almost all of your creature products.
When you finish, leave Yasir's boat the same way you came and go down to the quay: you are back at the city port (Carlin, Ankrahmun or Liberty Bay), where the normal boats are.
